records.pre_race_description: A clear sky and a readable course. The race remains subject to ordinary hazards.
records.radio_cue: The sky is clear; now it is down to the racers.
records.visual_brief: Clear visibility; crisp long shadows, dry track, high-contrast sunlit silhouettes.

records.pre_race_description: Rain darkens the racing surface and complicates grip and sightlines.
records.radio_cue: Rain is falling, and every racing line deserves a second look.
records.visual_brief: Wet stone and earth, restrained reflective highlights, slanted rainfall against dark silhouettes.

records.pre_race_description: Heavy rain reduces visibility and grip under the existing weather rules. Track segment terrain remains unchanged.
records.radio_cue: Heavy rain is coming down; visibility and traction will be tested.
records.visual_brief: Dense rain and dramatic low-visibility lighting; no newly created mud segments, standing-water hazards, or terrain conversion.

records.pre_race_description: Wind carries dust across the course, making distant movement harder to read.
records.radio_cue: Dust is blowing across the course; the far end of the track is disappearing in the haze.
records.visual_brief: Low ochre dust streamers, angular gust patterns, obscured horizon but legible foreground.

records.pre_race_description: Heat shimmers above the track, demanding careful management of effort.
records.radio_cue: The heat is punishing out there, and the race has barely begun.
records.visual_brief: Amber heat haze, bleached stone highlights and hard black shadows; avoid literal fire.
